site.title: Kestrel Falls '07
site.tagline: Kestrel Falls High, Class of 2007: twenty years on
site.intro: One weekend in June, back where it started. Come for the Friday mixer, stay for Saturday's picnic and dinner. Partners and kids welcome all weekend.
site.description: The Kestrel Falls High Class of 2007 twenty-year reunion: June 11 to 13, 2027.

notice.text: Changed: Saturday's picnic has moved from Elm Park to the Lakeside Pavilion, same time.

site.about:
Six of us from the old student council, give or take. We've booked the rooms, counted the chairs and found the yearbook.

If you know a classmate who isn't on the list, send them this page.

data.title: Friday night mixer
data.summary: Name tags, a cash bar and the yearbook slideshow on a loop.
data.body: Drop in any time. The back room is ours all night.

data.title: Family picnic
data.summary: Bring a blanket. Lunch, games for the kids, a campus walk at two.

data.title: Reunion dinner
data.summary: A seated dinner, a few words from the class president and a band until late.
data.body: Dress is smart casual. Tickets include dinner and two drinks.

schedule.title: A few words, and the class photo

data.title: Sunday farewell brunch
data.summary: We couldn't get the room. Breakfast is on your own; see you at dinner instead.

data.title: The hotel block is open
data.summary: Thirty rooms at the group rate, until May 1.
data.body:
We've held thirty rooms at the Kestrel Falls Inn, a short walk from the Lantern Room. Book with the group code on the hotel page and the rate holds until **May 1**.

If you're driving in, parking at the inn is free for guests.

data.title: In memory
data.summary: Classmates we've lost, and a table for them at dinner.
data.body: We'll set a table at dinner with their photos. Send us a picture and a line about them.

data.name: What does it cost?
data.description: The mixer and picnic are free. Dinner tickets cover the meal and two drinks.

data.name: What do I wear?
data.description: Whatever you like on Friday and Saturday afternoon. Smart casual for dinner.

data.name: Can I bring my family?
data.description: Yes, to everything. Kids under twelve eat free at the picnic.

data.name: Where do I park?
data.description: Free lots behind the Lantern Room and at the club. The pavilion has street parking only.

data.name: Kestrel Falls Inn
data.subtitle: Group rate, two blocks from Main Street
data.description: Ask for the Kestrel Falls '07 block when you book.

data.name: Lakeview Motel
data.subtitle: By the pavilion
data.description: Simple rooms, a pool for the kids.
